assessment.summary: Beta.97 source review: Aquarea 1.6.0 to 1.7.0 adds only the zone climate auto_mode attribute (heat/cool while AUTO, otherwise null), documentation, tests and the version bump. The attribute also exists while idle and is selected-side information, never independent running, compressor, learning or SG safety evidence. SolarPilot already resolves AUTO_HEAT/AUTO_COOL from the current bound typed device.mode; no attribute fallback or runtime change is needed. Device polling, status/action mapping, writes, tank behavior, energy sensors and the SDK requirement are unchanged. SDK main and latest stable 1.3.1 remain identical to the prior pin; PR12 remains open and unmerged. The detailed assessment and bounded read-only regressions are recorded in docs/AQUAREA_UPSTREAM_REVIEW_BETA97.md.
